grok_report.summary: Price/percentage figures for individual watchlist names (AAPL, PLTR, NVDA) check out against real data, and the chip-licensing item is accurate. However, the briefing significantly mischaracterizes the Hormuz/Iran situation (downplaying an active war and omitting today's ceasefire pause, which is the actual reason oil is plunging) and misses the dominant market story of the day — AI infrastructure 'circular financing' fears from the Nvidia-SK Group/OpenAI mega-deals driving the chip-sector sell-off. These are not minor omissions; they invert or obscure the actual causal narrative behind today's market mood.
